After an intensive four day long operation in the deeper reaches of Kulgam in the Kashmir Valley, one Lashkar-e-Taiba operative was killed on Monday, while another is believed to be in the area. The operation, which is still underway, was launched following an attack on 11 November that left three Central Reserve Police Force personnel injured. Watch this video by Ananya Bhardwaj to know the full story.
